descriptions.en: A HACS custom integration for local Bluetooth GATT control of MiniBig window openers and PushMini/SwitchMini devices, without a cloud account or HubMini.
descriptions.ko: MiniBig 창문 오프너와 PushMini/SwitchMini를 클라우드 계정·HubMini 없이 로컬 Bluetooth GATT로 제어하는 HACS 커스텀 통합입니다.

categories_review.source: Reviewed 2026-10-20 by implementation; independent review tracked in ADOPTION_CHECKLIST.md. Primary blinds_curtains: MiniBig Window Opener controls window travel position and stop (custom_components/minibig/minibig_ble/devices.py PROFILE_WINDOW_OPENER/get_device_profile; docs/usage.md Supported Devices and Verified DP Mapping). Secondary plugs_switches: PushMini switch actuator and SwitchMini switch products (PROFILE_PUSH_MINI_NEW/LEGACY, PROFILE_SWITCH_MINI and docs/usage.md, retaining the documented unconfirmed SwitchMini power DP limitation). HubMini is explicitly unsupported. Product purpose, not entity platforms, determines these choices.
